note: Look ids for shot3d.json `look` and style.yaml `render.look` (engine: blender). tools/blender/looks.py builds each one (materials, lines, world, colour management); spec.py reads the ids from here. Colours are sRGB hex; world.paper / world.ink of a shot override paper / ink. samples = EEVEE TAA samples / Cycles samples (final, preview). lines: Freestyle ink lines in the beauty pass (line_px at 1080 lines tall, scaled with the frame). The line/depth/normal/mask control passes are the same for every look.

grey-layout.name: Grey layout
grey-layout.use: flat grey clay playblast: composition, camera and motion input for the AI bridge (Wan / LTX layout-to-render)

clay.name: Clay
clay.use: soft lit clay with the assets' colours: turntables, asset review (G2)

toon-ink.name: Toon ink
toon-ink.use: cel-shaded colour (three tones) with solid ink outlines on warm paper

ink-wash.name: Ink wash
ink-wash.use: the 3D counterpart of styles/thuy-mac: graded ink washes on aged rice paper, thin tapered brush lines, mist by depth and at the feet of mountains
